newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: Zaire's Kabila arrives in Cape Town for talks.
newsitem.headline: Zaire's Kabila arrives in Cape Town for talks.

text.p: Zairean rebel leader Laurent Kabila arrived in Cape town on Thursday to meet President Nelson Mandela, a day after Kabila scuppered scheduled peace talks with President Mobutu Sese Seko.

Mandela, bidding to rescue Zairean peace talks, sent the jet to the Angolan enclave of Cabinda to fetch the rebel leader, who on Wednesday refused at the last minute to meet Mobutu on a South African ship, citing security concerns.
President Mandela's spokesman Parks Mankahlana said Kabila was expected to meet the president privately for about 45 minutes before they are joined by United Nations special envoy Mohamed Sahnoun.
"We are vey optimistic ... we have reason to be optimistic," he said.
Mandela has tabled a two-page proposal for a transition to democracy in Zaire after 32 years of Mobutu's autocratic rule.
